1. # ***Introduction***

   1. ## ***System Overview***

**DASIGConnect** is a centralized, web-based **Social Media Content Workflow and Scheduling Management System** developed as a capstone project (Team Code: *2526-sem2-it332-38*) for the **DOST Acadême–Science and Innovation Group (DASIG)** under the Department of Science and Technology (DOST) Region 7\. The system replaces informal, ad hoc social media coordination across member Higher Education Institutions (HEIs)—such as Cebu Institute of Technology – University (CIT-U), Silliman University, and partner institutions—with a structured, traceable, role-based digital workflow integrated with the official DASIG Facebook Page.

DASIGConnect is engineered around a three-layer operational model designed to eliminate the administrative coordination bottleneck:

1. **Layer 1 — Self-Service (Contributors):** Institutional representatives draft event posts, attach media, utilize advisory AI tools, and self-schedule content within software-enforced guard rails.

2. **Layer 2 — Automation (System Rules and Cron Jobs):** Deterministic scheduling guard rails (30-minute conflict buffer, 2-hour minimum lead time, 30-day maximum horizon, 8:00 AM–8:00 PM posting window, 6-post daily cap, and 3-post active institutional quota) and 16 background scheduled jobs handle conflict prevention, automated Facebook Graph API publishing, stale-submission sweeps, embedding reconciliation, and multi-channel notifications.

3. **Layer 3 — Governance & Exception Handling (Moderators and Administrators):** Network-wide Moderators and Administrators triage and review the Validation Queue (*Approve*, *Request Revision*, *Reject*, or *Edit & Approve*), while Administrators retain exclusive authority over system governance, guard-rail overrides, manual publishing fallback, token re-authentication, watermark configuration, System Health, and the append-only Audit Log.

Architecturally, DASIGConnect operates as a three-tier client-server application:

* **Presentation Tier:** A React 19 \+ TypeScript Single-Page Application (SPA) built with Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Radix UI / shadcn/ui, FullCalendar, Axios, and Server-Sent Events (SSE), deployed on Vercel.

* **Application Tier:** A stateless Spring Boot 4.0.6 (Java 21\) REST API (*/api/v1*) deployed on Railway/Render, enforcing JWT authentication (8-hour TTL with database-backed revocation), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), tenant scoping, state machines, and background cron scheduling.

* **Data & Storage Tier:** Supabase PostgreSQL with the *pgvector* extension (*VECTOR(1024)* cosine similarity) and Row-Level Security (RLS) policies for multi-institution tenant isolation, paired with Cloudflare R2 S3-compatible object storage using presigned *PUT* uploads and backend-proxied reads (*/api/v1/media-files/*).

* **External Integrations:** Meta Facebook Graph API (v25.0) and Messenger Platform webhook, Anthropic Claude API (claude-haiku-4-5: captions, writing check, top-post templates, content ideas), Google Gemini API (gemini-3.8-flash: image classification and metadata), Voyage AI Embedding API (voyage-4-lite text and voyage-multimodal-3.5 image, 1024 dimensions), and Resend HTTP-API transactional email delivery.

  2. ## ***Test Approach***

Testing for DASIGConnect follows a multi-layered **Verification and Validation (V\&V)** strategy aligned with the project's Agile/Scrum 2-week sprint methodology, verifying every functional use case (*UC-1.1* through *UC-3.6*), business rule (*BR-ACC* through *BR-AI*), guard rail (*GR-H1*–*GR-T9*), non-functional requirement (*SRS Section 3.4*), and multi-tenant security boundary (*SRS Section 3.5*).

1. **Unit & Service-Layer Testing (White-Box):**

   * **Scope:** Business logic, state transitions, guard-rail calculations, account caps, password complexity validation, review lock lifecycles, watermark coordinate scaling, and CSV sanitization across all Spring Boot *@Service* classes.

   * **Technique:** Isolated unit tests using **JUnit 5 (Jupiter)**, **Mockito** (*@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)*), and **AssertJ**. External APIs (Facebook Graph API, Anthropic Claude, Voyage AI, Cloudflare R2, Gemini, Resend) are mocked to deterministically test both normal execution and failure/timeout branches (*503*, *504*, *429*, exponential backoff).

2. **API Controller & Security Slice Testing (Grey-Box):**

   * **Scope:** REST endpoint contracts under */api/v1/*, request payload validation (*400 Bad Request*, *422 Unprocessable Entity*), conflict handling (*409 Conflict*, *423 Locked*), JWT filter authentication (*401 Unauthorized*), and role-based authorization (*@PreAuthorize* returning *403 Forbidden* or *404 Not Found* for cross-tenant isolation).

   * **Technique:** Spring *@WebMvcTest* slices importing *SecurityConfig* and executed via *MockMvc*.

3. **Database Migration, Concurrency & Tenant Isolation Testing (Integration):**

   * **Scope:** Flyway schema migrations (*V1*–*V122*), PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) policies (*app.current\_institution\_id*, *app.current\_role*), append-only audit log enforcement (*V78* RLS blocking *UPDATE*/*DELETE*), atomic conditional claims (*claimForPublishing*, *claimModeratorReschedule*), and the PostgreSQL GiST exclusion constraint (*V95*/*V96*) preventing concurrent *±30-minute* slot reservation races.

   * **Technique:** Repository/service integration tests and live SQL verification against PostgreSQL / H2 test contexts.

4. **End-to-End (E2E), UI Workflow & Performance Regression Testing (Black-Box):**

   * **Scope:** Full browser-level user journeys across Contributor, Moderator, and Administrator personas, including workspace bootstrap, SSE real-time notification badge updates (*INC*, *READ\_SYNC*), debounced media search, 3-step post drafting, validation queue tab switching, FullCalendar event loading, analytics rendering, and bundle size budget verification.

   * **Technique:** Automated headless Chromium browser tests using **Playwright (***@playwright/test***)** against the production-mode Vite preview build (*npm run test:e2e*, *npm run test:performance*, *npm run check:bundle*) plus structured manual walkthroughs of visual/canvas interactions.

5. **Defect Tracking & Regression Verification:**

   * Any discrepancy between the SRS (including its use case specifications) and system behavior is logged as an Incident in **Appendix A.3**, classified by severity, root-caused to the specific service/controller/component, and re-tested upon resolution.

   3. ## ***Definitions and Acronyms***

| Term / Acronym | Definition |
| :---- | :---- |
| **ACTIVE / PENDING / EXPIRED / INACTIVE / CANCELLED** | User account lifecycle states governed by the User Account State Machine (*SRS Section 1.4*). |
| **Admin Owner** | Governance designation (*is\_admin\_owner \= true*) held by exactly one active Administrator at a time; required for actions targeting existing Admin accounts, erasing personal data, switching the connected Facebook Page, and transferring ownership (*UC-1.1*). |
| **Administrator** | Network-wide user role (*role \= admin*, *institution\_id \= NULL*) with full governance, approval, scheduling override, exception handling, System Health, Watermark, and Audit Log authority. |
| **Contributor** | Institution-scoped user role (*role \= contributor*) responsible for drafting posts, uploading media, and self-scheduling content within guard rails for their assigned member HEI. |
| **CWE-1236** | Common Weakness Enumeration for Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File (Formula Injection), mitigated by prepending an apostrophe (*'*) to cells starting with *\=*, *\+*, *\-*, *@*, *\\t*, or *\\r*. |
| **DASIG** | DOST Acadême–Science and Innovation Group under DOST Region 7\. |
| **DASIG Central Visayas** | Protected network-default institution seeded at deployment; exempt from deactivation and permanent deletion (*UC-1.2 A6, A8*). |
| **DRAFT / PENDING / IN\_REVIEW / NEEDS\_REVISION / SCHEDULED / PUBLISHING / PUBLISHED / PUBLISHED\_MANUAL / PUBLISH\_FAILED / MISSED\_REVIEW / REJECTED** | Submission lifecycle states governed by the content workflow state machine (*SRS Section 1.3 & 3.2*). |
| **E2E** | End-to-End testing conducted through a real browser environment (Playwright \+ Chromium). |
| **Fast-Track (Live Event)** | Submission mode (*UC-1.5*, *UC-1.9 A5*, *UC-3.2 A5*) that bypasses scheduled-slot guard rails, sorts to the top of the active Validation Queue, and publishes asynchronously immediately upon approval. |
| **GiST** | Generalized Search Tree index in PostgreSQL, used in migration *V95*/*V96* to enforce database-level exclusion constraints on overlapping *±30-minute* slot reservations. |
| **Guard Rail (***GR-H\****,** *GR-S\****,** *GR-T\****)** | System-enforced business rule classified as Hard (*GR-H1..H4*, blocks action), Soft (*GR-S1..S2*, warns actor), or Trigger (*GR-T1..T9*, autonomous cron action). |
| **HEI** | Higher Education Institution participating in the DASIG network (e.g., CIT-U, Silliman University). |
| **JWT** | JSON Web Token used for stateless 8-hour session authentication (*HS256*), carrying *role*, *session\_version*, and *institution\_id* (for Contributors). |
| **Moderator** | Network-wide reviewer role (*role \= moderator*, *institution\_id \= NULL*, formerly termed *Validator*) with access to the network-wide Validation Queue, Master Calendar (with capped rescheduling), and Contributor invitation management (*UC-1.10*). |
| **MockMvc** | Spring Test framework component allowing HTTP controller testing with full Spring Security filter chains without starting an external servlet container. |
| **pgvector** | PostgreSQL extension storing 1024-dimensional Voyage AI embeddings (*VECTOR(1024)*) for cosine-distance (*\<=\>*) semantic similarity search. |
| **R2** | Cloudflare R2 S3-compatible object storage used for raw media assets and temporary watermarked derivatives. |
| **RBAC** | Role-Based Access Control enforced server-side via Spring Security *@PreAuthorize* and route gates. |
| **RLS** | PostgreSQL Row-Level Security enforcing multi-institution tenant isolation at the database engine layer (*SRS Section 3.5*). |
| **SSE** | Server-Sent Events (*GET /api/v1/notifications/stream*) used for real-time in-app notification delivery and cross-session read-state synchronization (*UC-3.3*). |
| **SRS** | Software Requirements Specification. |
| **STD** | Software Test Document (this document). |
| **SUS** | System Usability Scale questionnaire targeting a minimum score of ≥68 (*SRS Section 3.4.8*). |
| **Two-Step Publishing** | Verified Facebook Graph API photo publishing flow: Step 1 stages unpublished photos (*POST /{PAGE\_ID}/photos* with *published=false*), and Step 2 publishes a single feed post (*POST /{PAGE\_ID}/feed* with *attached\_media*). |

2. ## ***Features not to be Tested***

Based on the SRS (Sections 1.2, 2.3, and 3.3) and the scope boundaries documented in its use case specifications, the following features are explicitly excluded from testing:

1. **Integration with Non-Facebook Social Media Platforms (***SRS 1.2***,** *SRS 2.3***):** Publishing or analytics integration with Instagram, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok, or YouTube is out of scope; DASIGConnect is scoped exclusively to the official DASIG Facebook Page.

2. **Automated Publishing of Mixed-Media (Image \+ Video) Posts (***SRS 1.2***,** *UC-1.7 A7***,** *UC-3.2 A6***):** Due to structural Facebook Graph API constraints, combining photos and videos in a single automated feed call is not supported. Only the detection of mixed-media submissions and their routing to *PUBLISH\_FAILED* for Manual Publishing Fallback is tested.

3. **AI Classification, Vector Embedding, and Watermarking for Video Assets (***UC-2.1***,** *UC-2.5***,** *GR-T7***):** Video uploads (*MP4*, *MOV*, *WebM*) bypass Claude/Gemini image classification, Voyage AI vector embedding, and Java2D watermarking by design, transitioning immediately to *READY* and publishing unwatermarked.

4. **Generative AI Image Creation & Autonomous Content Moderation (***SRS 1.2***):** AI tools in DASIGConnect are strictly advisory; the system does not generate synthetic images or autonomously approve/publish Contributor posts without human review.

5. **Public Facebook Post Visibility Under Live Mode / Meta Business Verification (SRS 1.2,** *UC-3.2 A4***):** During development and capstone evaluation, the Meta Developer Application operates in **Development Mode** (posts visible to app role holders). Transitioning to Live Mode requires organizational Meta Business Verification by DOST/DASIG and is outside software testing scope.

6. **Contributor-Initiated Guard-Rail Override Requests (***SRS 3.3.1.2***):** Hard guard-rail violations (*GR-H1..H3*) strictly block Contributor slot selection and submission; only Administrators can override a hard guard rail during their own actions.

7. **Restore of Soft-Deleted Media by Non-Administrators (UC-2.3 A5):** The Trash (list, restore, purge, empty) is Administrator-only; Contributors and Moderators have no self-service restore. Only the 403 response for non-Administrators is tested (Case-26).  
8. **Per-Channel and Per-Event Notification Opt-Out Toggles (***BR-NOT-04***):** Granular notification preference toggles are out of scope for the pilot; all in-app and email triggers are mandatory for their target roles, with only Facebook Messenger delivery operating as an individual opt-in via account linking (*UC-1.4 A8*).

9. **Initial Seeded Admin Provisioning & Unreachable Admin Owner Recovery (***UC-1.1 Preconditions & A11***):** The initial Admin Owner account is seeded at deployment, and recovery from an unreachable Admin Owner is an organizational governance procedure outside application scope.

10. **Internal Uptime & SLA of Third-Party Cloud Providers:** Internal availability of Meta's Graph API servers, Anthropic's Claude inference cluster, Voyage AI's embedding cluster, Supabase's managed PostgreSQL infrastructure, and Cloudflare R2's global storage network are not tested; only DASIGConnect's resilience, timeouts, retries, and graceful degradation when calling these interfaces are tested.

3. # ***Test Cases***

   1. ## ***Case-1: Administrator Account Management & 3-Admin Cap Enforcement (UC-1.1)***

      1. ### ***Purpose***

Verify that an active Administrator can invite a new Administrator using a 72-hour single-use SHA-256 hashed invitation token, that the uniform **3-Admin cap** (*ACTIVE* Admins \+ pending Admin invitations \+ pending Admin promotions ≤ 3\) is strictly enforced across invitation, activation, promotion, and reactivation gates (*UC-1.1 Main Flow & A2*), and that Admin Owner authority is required to deactivate, reactivate, delete, or erase an existing Administrator account (*UC-1.1 A3–A6*).

2. ### ***Inputs***

* **Authenticated Actor 1:** Admin Owner (*administrator@dasigconnect.com*, *role \= admin*, *isAdminOwner \= true*, *state \= ACTIVE*).

* **Authenticated Actor 2:** Peer Administrator (*admin.second@dasigconnect.com*, *role \= admin*, *isAdminOwner \= false*, *state \= ACTIVE*).

* **New Admin Invitee Email:** *admin.third@dasigconnect.com* ( takes slot 3 of 3\) and *admin.fourth@dasigconnect.com* (exceeds cap of 3).

* **Activation Payload:** Raw 64-character hex token from email, password *"DasigAdmin\#2026\!Secure"*.

  3. ### ***Expected Outputs & Pass/Fail Criteria***

* **Expected Outputs:**

  1. Inviting *admin.third@dasigconnect.com* succeeds (*HTTP 200/201*), creating a *PENDING* user with *institution\_id \= NULL* and storing only the SHA-256 token hash.

  2. Attempting to invite *admin.fourth@dasigconnect.com* while 2 active Admins and 1 pending Admin invite exist is rejected (*HTTP 409/422*) with an Admin limit reached error (*UC-1.1 A2*).

  3. Activating *admin.third@dasigconnect.com* re-validates the cap, transitions the account to *ACTIVE*, and logs *INVITATION\_ACCEPTED*.

  4. Peer Administrator (*isAdminOwner \= false*) attempting to deactivate *admin.third@dasigconnect.com* is rejected with *HTTP 403 Forbidden*.

  5. Admin Owner (*isAdminOwner \= true*) deactivating *admin.third@dasigconnect.com* succeeds, transitions status to *INACTIVE*, increments *session\_version* to revoke all active JWT sessions, and records *USER\_STATUS\_UPDATED*.

  6. Attempting to re-invite an *INACTIVE* Admin is rejected (*HTTP 409 Conflict*), directing the actor to use Reactivation (*UC-1.1 A4*).

* **Pass/Fail Criteria:** **PASS** if all 6 assertions hold and audit log entries match *UC-1.1* postconditions; **FAIL** otherwise.

  4. ### ***Test Procedure***

1. Authenticate as *administrator@dasigconnect.com* and navigate to **Admin Management**.

2. Submit **Invite Admin** for *admin.third@dasigconnect.com*; verify *PENDING* record creation and hashed token persistence.

3. Submit **Invite Admin** for *admin.fourth@dasigconnect.com*; verify the 3-Admin cap blocks the request (*UC-1.1 A2*).

4. Complete the activation link flow for *admin.third@dasigconnect.com* with a valid password; verify transition to *ACTIVE*.

5. Authenticate as Peer Admin (*admin.second@dasigconnect.com*) and attempt *Deactivate* on *admin.third@dasigconnect.com*; verify *403 Forbidden*.

6. As Admin Owner, execute *Deactivate* on *admin.third@dasigconnect.com*; verify status becomes *INACTIVE*, sessions are revoked, and re-inviting *admin.third@dasigconnect.com* is blocked in favor of *Reactivate*.

   2. ## ***Case-2: Admin Promotion Proposal & Admin Owner Transfer Governance (UC-1.1 A7, A8)***

      1. ### ***Purpose***

Verify the two-step propose/confirm workflow for promoting an existing Moderator or Contributor to Administrator (UC-1.1 A7) and the Admin Owner transfer workflow (UC-1.1 A8) restricted strictly to an existing active Administrator target (preventing demotion of the outgoing Owner).

2. ### ***Inputs***

* **Proposing Actor:** Admin Owner (*administrator@dasigconnect.com*, *isAdminOwner \= true*).

* **Target 1 (Promotion):** Active Moderator (*moderator@dasigconnect.com*, *role \= moderator*, *institution\_id \= NULL*).

* **Target 2 (Admin-to-Admin Owner Transfer):** Active Peer Admin (*admin.peer@dasig.org*, *role \= admin*, *isAdminOwner \= false*)

  3. ### ***Expected Outputs & Pass/Fail Criteria***

* **Expected Outputs:**

  1. Proposing *moderator@dasigconnect.com* for Admin promotion reserves a slot against the 3-Admin cap, creates a pending 72-hour promotion request without immediately changing *moderator*'s role, and logs *ADMIN\_PROMOTION\_REQUESTED*.

  2. When *moderator@dasigconnect.com* confirms the promotion, the system re-checks the 3-Admin cap, promotes the account to *admin* (*isAdminOwner \= false*), revokes active sessions, and logs *ADMIN\_PROMOTION\_CONFIRMED*.

  3. Attempting to initiate an Admin Owner Transfer to a Moderator target (*moderator@dasigconnect.com*) is rejected (HTTP 400 Bad Request), enforcing that only active Administrators can receive Admin Owner status.  
  4. When Admin Owner initiates an **Admin Owner Transfer** to an existing Administrator (*admin.second@dasigconnect.com*), initiation logs *ADMIN\_TRANSFER\_REQUESTED* with a 24-hour expiry; upon confirmation by *admin.second@dasigconnect.com*, *admin.second* becomes *admin* with *isAdminOwner \= true*, the outgoing Owner relinquishes *isAdminOwner \= false* while remaining an *admin*, outgoing active sessions are revoked, and *ADMIN\_TRANSFER\_CONFIRMED* is logged.

* **Pass/Fail Criteria:** **PASS** if promotion propose/confirm/decline/cancel, Moderator-target transfer rejection (400), and Admin-to-Admin Owner transfer succeed per specification; **FAIL** if Admin-target Owner transfer confirmation fails with a role-gating error.

  4. ### ***Test Procedure***

1. As Admin Owner (with *\< 3* total occupied Admin slots), propose promoting *moderator@dasigconnect.com* to Admin.

2. Verify *ADMIN\_PROMOTION\_REQUESTED* is written and a second concurrent promotion proposal for *moderator@dasigconnect.com* is rejected.

3. Log in as *moderator@dasigconnect.com*, confirm the promotion, and verify role elevation to *admin* and session invalidation.

4. Attempt Admin Owner transfer initiation to a Moderator target; verify rejection with HTTP 400 Bad Request.

5. Test Admin Owner transfer initiation to an existing Administrator target (*admin.second@dasigconnect.com*) and confirm via \`POST /api/v1/users/admin-transfer/confirm\`; verify *admin.second@dasigconnect.com* becomes Admin Owner while outgoing Owner remains Administrator.

   3. ## ***Case-3: Institution Lifecycle & Protected Default Institution Safeguards (UC-1.2)***

      1. ### ***Purpose***

Verify institution creation, duplicate detection, Contributor reassignment, deactivation gating, permanent deletion rules, read-only Moderator visibility, and unconditional protection of the seeded default institution *"DASIG Central Visayas"* (*UC-1.2 Main Flow & A1–A8*).

2. ### ***Inputs***

* **Actors:** Administrator (*administrator@dasigconnect.com*) and Moderator (*moderator@dasigconnect.com*).

* **New Institution Payload:** Name *"Cebu Institute of Technology \- University"*, Code *"CITU"*, Domain *"cit.edu"*.

* **Protected Institution:** *"DASIG Central Visayas"*.

  3. ### ***Expected Outputs & Pass/Fail Criteria***

* **Expected Outputs:**

  1. Moderator viewing **Institution Management** sees all institutions in read-only mode; direct API attempts by Moderator to create/edit/deactivate/delete an institution return *HTTP 403 Forbidden* (*UC-1.2 A7*).

  2. Administrator creating *"CITU"* succeeds (*ACTIVE* status); attempting to create another institution with duplicate name, code, or domain returns *HTTP 409 Conflict* (*UC-1.2 A5*).

  3. Attempting to deactivate *"CITU"* while an active Contributor is assigned is blocked (*HTTP 409/422*) until the Contributor is reassigned to another *ACTIVE* institution (*UC-1.2 A2, A4*).

  4. Attempting to deactivate or permanently delete *"DASIG Central Visayas"* is unconditionally rejected (*UC-1.2 A6, A8*).

  5. Permanent deletion (*UC-1.2 A8*) of an eligible empty institution succeeds only when the exact institution code is confirmed and no active/pending Contributors, submissions of any state, or non-deleted media assets exist; logs *INSTITUTION\_DELETED*.

* **Pass/Fail Criteria:** **PASS** if all creation, duplicate, reassignment, protection, and permanent deletion guards behave as specified; **FAIL** otherwise.

  4. ### ***Test Procedure***

1. Log in as Moderator, open **Institution Management**, verify action controls are hidden, and send a *POST /api/v1/institutions* request; assert *403 Forbidden*.

2. Log in as Administrator, create institution *"CITU"*, then repeat with the same code *"CITU"*; assert duplicate rejection.

3. Assign a Contributor to *"CITU"* and attempt to deactivate *"CITU"*; assert rejection. Reassign the Contributor to another active institution (verifying historical submissions retain their original institution attribution), then deactivate *"CITU"*.

4. Attempt to deactivate and delete *"DASIG Central Visayas"*; assert both actions are blocked.

5. Create a footprint-free test institution *"TEST-HEI"*, confirm its code in the Permanent Delete dialog, and verify removal and *INSTITUTION\_DELETED* audit logging.

   4. ## ***Case-4: Contributor Account Provisioning & Footprint-Aware Deletion (UC-1.3)***

      1. ### ***Purpose***

Verify Contributor invitation by both Administrators and Moderators, institution-status validation (*BR-ACC-01*), Moderator ownership scoping on sent invitations (*UC-1.3 A5, A6*), footprint-aware account deletion (*USER\_REMOVED* vs. hard-delete), and Admin Owner Right-to-be-Forgotten erasure (*UC-1.3 A7*).

2. ### ***Inputs***

* **Actors:** Administrator (*administrator@dasigconnect.com*), Moderator 1 (moderator@dasigconnect.com), Moderator 2 (moderator2@dasigconnect.com).

* **Expected Outputs:**

  1. Moderator 1 can invite *contrib.citu@cit.edu* to any *ACTIVE* institution with role restricted to *contributor*; inviting to an *INACTIVE* institution is rejected (*BR-ACC-01*).

  2. Moderator 2 attempting to resend, cancel, or delete Moderator 1's pending invitation is rejected (*HTTP 403 Forbidden*), whereas Moderator 1 succeeds (*UC-1.3 A5, A6*).

  3. Once *contrib.citu@cit.edu* activates their account and creates a submission or uploads media (establishing a historical footprint), deactivating (*INACTIVE*) and then deleting the account does **not** hard-delete the database row; instead, it persists as an anonymized inactive record with a *USER\_REMOVED* audit entry (*UC-1.3 A6*).

  4. Deleting *contrib.fresh@cit.edu* (cancelled/expired with zero footprint) hard-deletes the row.

  5. Admin Owner executing **Erase** (*UC-1.3 A7*) on an *INACTIVE* Contributor anonymizes PII in place and logs *USER\_ANONYMIZED*.

* **Pass/Fail Criteria:** **PASS** if Moderator scoping, institution-status checks, footprint-preserving soft-removal, and PII erasure all match *UC-1.3*; **FAIL** otherwise.

2. Authenticate as Moderator 2 and attempt to cancel or resend *contrib.citu@cit.edu*'s invite; assert *403 Forbidden*.

3. Activate *contrib.citu@cit.edu*, create a draft submission, then as Administrator deactivate and delete *contrib.citu@cit.edu*; verify the row remains in the database anonymized at rest with *USER\_REMOVED* logged.

4. Invite and cancel *contrib.fresh@cit.edu* (zero footprint), then delete the account; verify hard deletion.

5. As Admin Owner, invoke *Erase* on an *INACTIVE* account and verify *USER\_ANONYMIZED* audit logging.

   5. ## ***Case-5: Authentication, Account Lockout, Password Policy & DB Session Revocation (UC-1.4)***

      1. ### ***Purpose***

Verify login authentication, JWT claims scoping, 5-attempt / 15-minute account lockout (*UC-1.4 A1*), password complexity enforcement (*UC-1.4 A5, A6*), single-device logout (*revoked\_tokens*, *UC-1.4 A10*) vs. account-wide session invalidation (*session\_version*, *UC-1.4 A5*), session-expiry warning banner/modal (*UC-1.4 A7*), and 10-minute Facebook Messenger link-code generation (*UC-1.4 A8*).

2. ### ***Inputs***

* **Accounts:** Active Contributor (*contrib.citu@cit.edu*), Active Moderator (*mod.a@dasigconnect.com*), *PENDING* user, *INACTIVE* user.

* **Passwords Tested:**

  * Weak passwords: *"Short1\!"* (*\<12* chars), *"DasigWelcome123\!"* (contains forbidden fragment *"dasig"*/*"welcome"*/*"123"*), *"contrib.citu@cit.eduA1\!"* (contains email).

  * Valid password: *"Str0ng\#Pass\_987\!"* (≥12 chars, upper, lower, digit, special, no whitespace or forbidden fragments).

    3. ### ***Expected Outputs & Pass/Fail Criteria***

* **Expected Outputs:**

  1. Valid login returns an 8-hour JWT: Contributor token includes *institution\_id*; Moderator and Admin tokens have no *institution\_id* claim (*UC-1.4 Main Flow*).

  2. Five failed login attempts within 15 minutes lock the account for 15 minutes; further attempts return HTTP 401 with "Account temporarily locked. Try again later." and the lock is audited as ACCOUNT\_LOCKED (UC-1.4 A1).

  3. Login attempts by *PENDING*, *EXPIRED*, or *INACTIVE* accounts are rejected with state-specific guidance (*UC-1.4 A2–A4*).

  4. Password reset (*UC-1.4 A5*) rejects weak/fragment-containing passwords, accepts *"Str0ng\#Pass\_987\!"*, increments *users.session\_version*, and invalidates all existing JWTs across all devices.

  5. Authenticated password change (*UC-1.4 A6*) updates the password without incrementing *session\_version*, keeping other active sessions valid.

  6. Single-session logout (*POST /api/v1/auth/logout*, *UC-1.4 A10*) inserts the SHA-256 token hash into *revoked\_tokens*, rejecting subsequent requests with that token while leaving other device sessions active.

  7. Generating a Facebook Messenger link code (*UC-1.4 A8*) succeeds for Moderator and Administrator (10-minute code) and returns *HTTP 403 Forbidden* for Contributor.

* **Pass/Fail Criteria:** **PASS** if all authentication, lockout, password policy, DB-persisted token revocation, and Messenger link-code role checks pass; **FAIL** otherwise.

  4. ### ***Test Procedure***

1. Attempt 5 failed logins for *contrib.citu@cit.edu*; verify the 5th attempt triggers a 15-minute lockout (*423 Locked*).

2. Log in with valid Contributor and Moderator credentials on two separate sessions (Session 1 and Session 2); inspect decoded JWT payloads for *institution\_id* and *session\_version*.

3. Call *POST /api/v1/auth/logout* on Session 1; verify Session 1's JWT is rejected by *JWTService.extractClaims* (*revoked\_tokens*) while Session 2 remains valid.

4. Execute unauthenticated Password Reset (*A5*) testing both invalid fragments (*"dasig"*, *"123"*) and valid password *"Str0ng\#Pass\_987\!"*; verify Session 2 is immediately invalidated via *session\_version* mismatch.

5. As Contributor and Moderator, test *POST /api/v1/auth/messenger-link-code* (or Messenger connection endpoint); verify Moderator receives a 10-minute code and Contributor receives *403*.

4. When all 7 Required items pass and 1 Optional tip is unapplied (*Required: 7 of 7 ✓ — Ready to submit*, *Tips: 4 of 5 applied*), verify **Submit for Approval** is the primary always-visible action on every screen size and clicking it opens a non-blocking confirmation listing the unapplied tip (*UC-1.5 A7*, *REQ-124*).

5. As Administrator, toggle **Scheduling Guard Rails** OFF in **Settings → Page** and verify a Standard draft can be scheduled at *9:30 PM* (outside *8 AM–8 PM*) as long as the timestamp is in the future; re-enable Guard Rails afterward.

   8. ## ***Case-8: AI Caption Generation, Writing Check & Fancy Unicode Text Styling (UC-1.6)***

      1. ### ***Purpose***

Verify on-demand AI caption generation (*POST /api/v1/ai/caption*), prompt length & word-count validation, image downscaling (*\>5 MB*), *30/hour* rate limiting, interaction telemetry logging (*use* / *use\_then\_edited* / *dismiss* / *re\_generate*), advisory AI proofreading (**Check writing**, *POST /api/v1/ai/proofread*), *3,000*\-character caption cap, and Fancy Unicode text styling (*UC-1.6 Main Flow & A1–A7*).

2. ### ***Inputs***

* **Saved Draft:** Draft ID *sub-101* with 1 attached image (*6.2 MB* high-res JPEG).

* **AI Caption Prompt:** *"Highlight student robotics pitch winners in 120 words"* (≤280 chars), Tone: *energetic*.

* **Invalid Prompts:** 285-character prompt (*\>280* chars); prompt requesting *"Write a 2500 word essay"* (*\>2,000* words).

* **Fancy Text Selection:** Substring *"DASIG Innovation"* styled as *Bold Sans-Serif* then *Italic Serif* then *Plain*.

  3. ### ***Expected Outputs & Pass/Fail Criteria***

* **Expected Outputs:**

  1. Images *\>5 MB* are downscaled in-memory (*70% → 50% → 35% → 25% → 15%*) before base64 submission to Claude (*SRS 3.1.2*, *UC-1.6*).

  2. Valid caption request returns 1 caption in the selected tone within the 30-second timeout; inserting and subsequently editing the caption logs *use\_then\_edited* (*BR-AI-03*).

  3. Prompt *\>280* characters disables the Generate button client-side and returns *HTTP 400* server-side (*UC-1.6 A5*); requested word count *\>2,000* returns *HTTP 400*.

  4. Exceeding 30 caption requests/hour returns *HTTP 429* with reset headers (*BR-AI-07*); AI timeout (*504*) or unavailability (*503*) degrades gracefully and auto-recovers to idle after *\~5s* without blocking drafting (*UC-1.6 A1, A2*).

  5. Clicking **Check writing** invokes *POST /api/v1/ai/proofread* and displays advisory grammar/clarity suggestions that can be applied or dismissed.

  6. **Fancy Text** transforms *"DASIG Innovation"* into Unicode Mathematical Alphanumeric symbols, reverts to plain before applying a new style, leaves emoji/punctuation/accents untouched (*UC-1.6 A7*), and reverts cleanly to standard ASCII when *Plain* is selected (*UC-1.6 A6*).

  7. Captions exceeding *3,000* code points are trimmed on paste and rejected server-side (*400* on save, *422* on submit).

* **Pass/Fail Criteria:** **PASS** if all 7 expectations hold; **FAIL** otherwise.

  4. ### ***Test Procedure***

1. Open saved draft *sub-101* on Step 2 (**Post Details**) and click **Suggest Caption**.

2. Test a 285-char prompt and a *"2500 words"* prompt; verify client/server *400* validation.

3. Submit the valid *energetic* prompt with the *6.2 MB* image attached; verify downscaling, caption insertion, subsequent manual edit, and telemetry log entry (*use\_then\_edited*).

4. Click **Check writing** and verify proofreading suggestions render non-blockingly.

5. Highlight *"DASIG Innovation"*, open **Fancy text**, apply *Bold Sans-Serif*, switch to *Italic Serif*, and revert via *Plain*.

6. Paste a *3,100*\-character string into the caption field; verify client-side trimming to *3,000* code points and backend enforcement (*SubmissionService.MAX\_CAPTION\_CHARS \= 3000*).

  4. In the Media Caption modal, per-asset captions are capped at *500* characters, and *"Skip watermark for this image"* is shown for *photo1.jpg* but hidden for *clip.mp4*.

  6. On Step 3, clicking **Auto-Match** (*POST /api/v1/ai/submissions/{id}/suggest-album*) auto-applies the root album with an *"AI-matched"* badge when score ≥0.55, lists up to 3 ranked candidates inline when 0.32 ≤ score \< 0.55 (*UC-1.7 A8*), and leaves the field for manual entry with a notice when *\<0.32* (*UC-1.7 A8a*).

* **Pass/Fail Criteria:** **PASS** if file validation, 10-asset cap, per-asset caption/watermark controls, AI media suggestions, and tiered Album Auto-Match all pass; **FAIL** otherwise.

2. Upload *photo1.jpg*, open the Media Caption modal, enter a 500-char caption, and check *"Skip watermark for this image"*.

3. Upload *clip.mp4* to the same draft; verify the mixed-media inline warning appears and the watermark checkbox is absent on the video asset.

5. In Step 3, test **Auto-Match** against albums yielding confident (≥0.55), ambiguous (*0.32–0.54*), and low (*\<0.32*) similarity scores; verify the combobox behavior for each tier.

   10. ## ***Case-10: Peak-Hour Engagement Recommendations & Guard-Rail Filtering (UC-1.8)***

       1. ### ***Purpose***

  2. In Scenario 2 (*\<20* samples), the system falls back to **Tuesday / Wednesday / Thursday 6:00 PM** labeled as *"Best-practice guidance"* (*UC-1.8 A1*).

  3. For a **Live Event Fast-Track** draft, the scheduling and recommendation panel is completely hidden (*UC-1.8 Preconditions*).

  4. In Scenario 3, manually selecting a slot that triggers *GR-S1* or *GR-S2* displays an inline soft warning beneath the date/time fields while allowing the actor to proceed (*UC-1.8 A4*).

   11. ## ***Case-11: Draft Submission, Guard-Rail Re-Validation, Withdrawal & Fast-Track Prioritization (UC-1.9)***

       1. ### ***Purpose***

Verify final server-side completeness validation at submission (*assertContentComplete*), submit-time guard-rail conflict handling (*409 Conflict* redirecting to Step 3, *UC-1.9 A4*), notification dispatch to reviewers (*T-01* vs. *T-11*), withdrawal from *pending* vs. locked *in\_review* (*UC-1.9 A2*), resubmission from *needs\_revision* or *rejected* (*UC-1.9 A3*), and Fast-Track top-of-queue prioritization (*UC-1.9 A5*).

2. ### ***Inputs***

* **Standard Draft (***sub-std***):** Complete title, date, caption (≤3,000 chars), 1 media asset, album *"CIT-U Events"*, scheduled slot *T \+ 4 hours*.

* **Fast-Track Draft (***sub-ft***):** Complete fields, mode \= *Live Event Fast-Track* (no scheduled slot).

* **Competing Submission:** Another user claims *T \+ 4 hours* (or within *±30* minutes) moments before *sub-std* clicks confirm.

  3. ### ***Expected Outputs & Pass/Fail Criteria***

* **Expected Outputs:**

  1. If a concurrent reservation claims a slot within *±30* minutes of *sub-std* before submit completes, *POST /api/v1/submissions/{id}/submit* returns *HTTP 409 Conflict*, closes the confirmation modal, and redirects the composer to Step 3 (**Organize & Schedule**) with a prompt to pick a new time (*UC-1.9 A4*).

  2. With a valid conflict-free slot, submitting *sub-std* transitions status *draft → pending*, locks content from further editing, and dispatches notification *T-01*.

  3. Calling *POST /api/v1/submissions/{id}/withdraw* while *sub-std* is *pending* (and unlocked) transitions it back to *draft* and logs *SUBMISSION\_WITHDRAWN*; once a reviewer opens *sub-std* (*ReviewLock* exists, status *in\_review*), withdrawal is rejected with *HTTP 409 Conflict* (*UC-1.9 A2*).

  4. Submitting *sub-ft* (Fast-Track) skips slot validation, dispatches urgent notification *T-11* (in-app \+ email \+ Messenger), and sorts *sub-ft* to the top of the active Validation Queue (*fastTrack DESC, scheduledAt ASC NULLS LAST, submittedAt ASC*, *UC-1.9 A5*).

* **Pass/Fail Criteria:** **PASS** if completeness validation, *409* conflict step-redirect, withdrawal lock guard, and Fast-Track queue sorting all pass; **FAIL** otherwise.

  4. ### ***Test Procedure***

1. Open *sub-std* in the composer, simulate a concurrent slot reservation at the same time slot, and click **Submit for Approval**; verify *409 Conflict* returns the user to Step 3\.

2. Select a free future slot (≥2h lead time, within *8 AM–8 PM*), submit *sub-std*, and verify transition to *pending*.

3. Click **Withdraw** while *sub-std* has no *ReviewLock*; verify transition back to *draft*. Re-submit *sub-std*, acquire a *ReviewLock* as a Moderator, and attempt **Withdraw** as the Contributor; assert *409 Conflict*.

4. Submit *sub-ft* in **Live Event Fast-Track** mode and inspect the Validation Queue (*Pending* tab); verify *sub-ft* is ordered above all non-Fast-Track submissions.

   16. ## ***Case-16: Approval Workflow, 15-Minute Review Lock & Self-Review Prevention (UC-2.4)***

       1. ### ***Purpose***

Verify the network-wide Validation Queue (*UC-2.4*), 15-minute *ReviewLock* acquisition, concurrent read-only lock contention (*UC-2.4 A3*), automatic lock expiry cleanup (*UC-2.4 A4*, *BR-APP-01*), unconditional self-submission review blocking (*UC-2.4 A5*), and terminal decisions (*Approve*, *Request Revision* with *10–1,000* char remarks, and *Reject* with standardized reason codes *BR-APP-02, BR-APP-03*).

2. ### ***Inputs***

* **Reviewers:** Moderator 1 (*mod.a@dasigconnect.com*), Moderator 2 (*mod.b@dasigconnect.com*), Administrator (*administrator@dasigconnect.com*).

* **Submissions:**

  * *sub-citu-1*: Submitted by Contributor *contrib.citu@cit.edu*.

  * *sub-mod-self*: Submitted by Moderator 1 (*mod.a@dasigconnect.com*).

* **Revision Remarks:** *"Too short"* (*9* chars — invalid) vs. *"Please add the official DOST Region 7 partner acknowledgment and registration URL."* (*82* chars — valid).

* **Rejection Payload:** Code *INCOMPLETE\_CONTENT* (deprecated/invalid for reject) vs. *DUPLICATE\_EVENT* (valid) and *OTHER* (requires written notes).

  3. ### ***Expected Outputs & Pass/Fail Criteria***

* **Expected Outputs:**

  1. Moderator 1 opening *sub-citu-1* transitions it *pending → in\_review* and acquires a 15-minute *ReviewLock* (*BR-APP-01*).

  2. Moderator 2 opening *sub-citu-1* while Moderator 1 holds the lock sees who holds the lock and views the panel in read-only mode (*UC-2.4 A3*).

  3. If Moderator 1 takes no action for 15 minutes, *ReviewLockCleanupJob* releases the lock and reverts *sub-citu-1* from *in\_review* to *pending* (*UC-2.4 A4*).

  4. Moderator 1 attempting to acquire a review lock on or approve/reject their own submission (*sub-mod-self*) is unconditionally blocked (*HTTP 403/409 "Your own submission must be reviewed by another moderator"* , *UC-2.4 A5*).

  5. **Request Revision** rejects remarks *\<10* chars or *\>1,000* chars (*400/422*, *UC-2.4 A2*), and with valid remarks transitions *sub-citu-1* to *needs\_revision*, releases its *SlotReservation*, and notifies the Contributor (in-app \+ email).

  6. **Reject** rejects *INCOMPLETE\_CONTENT*/*WRONG\_FORMAT* with *HTTP 422* (directing to Request Revision), requires written notes when reason is *OTHER*, and with a valid code (*DUPLICATE\_EVENT*) transitions the post to *rejected* and releases its slot (*BR-APP-03*).

* **Pass/Fail Criteria:** **PASS** if lock exclusivity, 15-min timeout, self-review block, revision length bounds, and rejection reason validation all pass; **FAIL** otherwise.

  4. ### ***Test Procedure***

1. Log in as Moderator 1, navigate to **Validation Queue**, and click **Review** on *sub-citu-1*; verify *in\_review* state and 15-minute lock creation.

2. Log in as Moderator 2 in a second browser session and open *sub-citu-1*; verify action buttons are disabled and Moderator 1 is shown as the active reviewer.

3. As Moderator 1, attempt to review *sub-mod-self* (authored by Moderator 1); assert self-review block (*UC-2.4 A5*).

4. On *sub-citu-1*, click **Request Revision** with a 9-character remark (assert blocked), then submit the 82-character remark; verify transition to *needs\_revision* and slot release.

5. On another pending submission, test **Reject** with *OTHER* and empty notes (assert blocked), then with *DUPLICATE\_EVENT*; verify transition to *rejected* and verify the Contributor can later edit and resubmit (*UC-1.5 A4*, *UC-2.4 Postconditions*).

* **Edits Made:** Caption substantially rewritten (*\>20%* change → *Flagged* severity) and 1 library photo added (*Added Media*), followed by lock release, lock re-acquisition, and final **Approve**.

  3. ### ***Expected Outputs & Pass/Fail Criteria***

* **Expected Outputs:**

  1. Saving an inline caption edit runs the advisory AI writing check (*POST /api/v1/ai/proofread*) and displays a **Review & Save** diff summary with Undo; clicking **Restore original** reverts fields back to the Contributor's submitted values.

  2. Releasing the review lock after editing, re-acquiring the lock later in the same review cycle, and clicking **Approve** with no further edits still records *edited \= true* and preserves the full before/after diff across the entire review cycle (*UC-2.4 A10*).

  4. While *sub-late* holds an active *ReviewLock*, *StaleSubmissionDetectorJob* skips marking it *missed\_review*; clicking **Approve** normally returns *HTTP 409 Conflict* (slot passed), requiring either selecting a new future slot or (Administrator only) invoking *?publishNow=true*, which sets the slot to *NOW()*, publishes, and logs *LATE\_PUBLISH\_OVERRIDE*.

* **Pass/Fail Criteria:** **PASS** if cycle-wide diff persistence, *Restore original*, severity-tiered notifications, and *LATE\_PUBLISH\_OVERRIDE* all behave per *UC-2.4*; **FAIL** otherwise.

2. Release the lock on *sub-edit*, re-open *sub-edit* to acquire a new lock, and click **Approve** without making additional edits; verify the audit log and Contributor notifications record the edit made before the lock release.

3. Lock *sub-late* whose *scheduled\_at* is 2 minutes in the future, wait until *scheduled\_at \< NOW()*, verify the *"slot passed"* banner appears and *StaleSubmissionDetectorJob* does not steal the locked item, then as Administrator approve with *Publish Now* (*?publishNow=true*) and verify *LATE\_PUBLISH\_OVERRIDE* in the audit log.

On *sub-fail*, when Photo 2 staging fails, the system attempts *DELETE /{photo\_id\_1}* to clean up the orphaned photo (*UC-3.2 A1*), retries up to 3 times with backoff (*5s, 25s, 125s*), and upon exhaustion transitions to *PUBLISH\_FAILED*, surfaces any undeleted *unresolvedPhotoIds* (*photoIdsCleanupFailed*) in the Failed tab, and alerts Administrators (*T-06*).

   21. ## ***Case-21: Missed Slot Sweep (PUBLISH\_FAILED vs. MISSED\_REVIEW) & Manual Publishing Fallback (UC-3.2 A2, UC-2.4 A8)***

       1. ### ***Purpose***

Verify that *StaleSubmissionDetectorJob* (every 5 minutes, *GR-T9*) distinguishes between an already-approved *SCHEDULED* submission that missed its publish window (*→ PUBLISH\_FAILED*) and an unreviewed *PENDING* submission whose slot passed (*→ MISSED\_REVIEW*), and verify the 3-step **Manual Publishing Fallback** recovery workflow (*UC-2.4 A8*, *BR-PUB-04, BR-PUB-05*).

2. ### ***Inputs***

* **Stale Scheduled Submission (***sub-stale-sched***):** *status \= scheduled*, *scheduled\_at \= NOW() \- 10 minutes*.

* **Stale Unreviewed Submission (***sub-stale-pend***):** *status \= pending*, *scheduled\_at \= NOW() \- 10 minutes*, no active *ReviewLock*.

* **Stuck Fast-Track Submission (***sub-stuck-ft***):** *status \= publishing*, *scheduled\_at \= NULL*, *updated\_at \= NOW() \- 10 minutes*.

* **Manual Fallback Input:** Facebook Post URL *"https\://www\.facebook.com/DASIGRegion7/posts/123456789012345"*, manual publish timestamp, and notes *"Published manually during Graph API maintenance."*

  3. ### ***Expected Outputs & Pass/Fail Criteria***

* **Expected Outputs:**

  1. *StaleSubmissionDetectorJob* transitions *sub-stale-sched* (*scheduled*) to *PUBLISH\_FAILED* and surfaces it in the Validation Queue's **Failed** tab (*UC-3.2 A2*).

  2. *StaleSubmissionDetectorJob* transitions *sub-stale-pend* (*pending*) to *MISSED\_REVIEW*, releases its *SlotReservation*, and routes it back into the Approval Workflow rather than the Manual Publishing Fallback flow (*UC-3.2 A2*).

  3. *findStuckFastTrackPublishing* detects *sub-stuck-ft* (*publishing* with *scheduled\_at IS NULL* and *updated\_at \< NOW() \- 5 min*) and recovers it to *PUBLISH\_FAILED*.

  4. In the **Failed** tab, an Administrator completing the 3-step **Manual Publishing Fallback** (Download watermarked media → Copy caption → Paste valid Facebook Post URL & confirm) transitions *sub-stale-sched* to *PUBLISHED\_MANUAL*, releases its slot reservation, writes a complete audit entry (*BR-PUB-04*), notifies the Contributor (*T-05*), and includes the post in Analytics KPIs (*BR-PUB-05*).

  5. If a failed submission is retried onto a new schedule (*retryWithNewSchedule*), both *originalScheduledAt* and *moderatorRescheduleCount* reset to the new baseline (*UC-3.1 A1*).

* **Pass/Fail Criteria:** **PASS** if *PUBLISH\_FAILED* vs. *MISSED\_REVIEW* separation, stuck Fast-Track recovery, manual fallback completion, and reschedule-baseline reset all pass; **FAIL** otherwise.

  4. ### ***Test Procedure***

1. Seed *sub-stale-sched*, *sub-stale-pend*, and *sub-stuck-ft* past the 5-minute cutoff and run *StaleSubmissionDetectorJob*.

2. Verify *sub-stale-sched* and *sub-stuck-ft* transition to *PUBLISH\_FAILED* while *sub-stale-pend* transitions to *MISSED\_REVIEW* with its slot released.

3. Open *sub-stale-sched* in the Validation Queue **Failed** tab as Administrator, execute the 3-step Manual Publishing Fallback with the Facebook URL, and verify transition to *PUBLISHED\_MANUAL* and *T-05* notification.

4. On another *PUBLISH\_FAILED* submission that previously had *moderatorRescheduleCount \= 2*, execute **Retry with New Schedule** and verify *moderatorRescheduleCount* resets to *0* and *originalScheduledAt* updates to the new slot.

   22. ## ***Case-22: Real-Time SSE Notifications, Cross-Session Read Sync & Messenger Delivery (UC-3.3)***

       1. ### ***Purpose***

Verify the event-driven notification system (*UC-3.3*, *BR-NOT-01..04*), including recipient set determination (review triggers notifying **both** Moderators and Administrators), real-time SSE badge delivery without polling, cross-session *read* / *read-all* synchronization (*UC-3.3 A2*), isolation of email failures from in-app delivery (*UC-3.3 A1*), and opt-in Facebook Messenger DM delivery (*UC-3.3 A4, A5*).

2. ### ***Inputs***

* **Active Recipients:**

  * Moderator 1 (*mod.linked@dasigconnect.com* — Messenger linked, open in Browser Tab A and Browser Tab B).

  * Administrator 1 (*admin.unlinked@dasigconnect.com* — Messenger **not** linked).

  * Contributor 1 (*contrib.citu@cit.edu*).

* **Triggering Events:** New Fast-Track submission (*T-11*) by Contributor 1, followed by Moderator 1 clicking a notification in Tab A and clicking **Mark All Read**.

  3. ### ***Expected Outputs & Pass/Fail Criteria***

* **Expected Outputs:**

  1. Submitting the Fast-Track post dispatches *T-11* to **every active Moderator and every active Administrator** (*UC-3.3 Main Flow*).

  2. Both Moderator 1 and Administrator 1 receive instant in-app SSE *notification* events (*GET /api/v1/notifications/stream*), incrementing their navbar bell badges in real time without page refresh (*BR-NOT-01, BR-NOT-02*).

  3. Moderator 1 (Messenger linked) receives the outbound Facebook Messenger DM (*UC-3.3 A4*), whereas Administrator 1 (Messenger not linked) is silently skipped for Messenger while still receiving in-app and email notifications (*UC-3.3 A5*).

  4. When Moderator 1 marks a notification read (or clicks **Mark All Read**) in Browser Tab A, the backend pushes an SSE *read* / *read-all* event to Browser Tab B, synchronizing the unread badge count across both active sessions (*UC-3.3 A2*).

  5. A simulated email-provider failure is recorded once in email\_delivery\_log with status \= failed and the error detail, without retry, and does not delay or block the in-app SSE notification (UC-3.3 A1). Recipients with email notifications turned off receive no email and no log row (BR-NOT-04).

* **Pass/Fail Criteria:** **PASS** if Moderator+Admin fan-out, real-time SSE badge updates, cross-tab read sync, Messenger opt-in filtering, and email failure isolation all pass; **FAIL** otherwise.

  4. ### ***Test Procedure***

1. Open two simultaneous authenticated browser tabs (Tab A and Tab B) for *mod.linked@dasigconnect.com* and one tab for *admin.unlinked@dasigconnect.com*.

2. Submit a Fast-Track post as *contrib.citu@cit.edu*; verify both *mod.linked* and *admin.unlinked* receive the in-app SSE notification within *\<5* seconds and only *mod.linked* receives a Messenger dispatch.

3. Click the unread notification in Tab A of *mod.linked*; verify Tab B's unread badge decrements automatically via SSE *read* sync without refreshing the page.

4. Make the email provider (Resend API) throw during a *T-02* approval notification; verify the in-app notification still arrives immediately and *email\_delivery\_logs* records the retry state.

     * **Moderator:** Sees network-wide metrics across all institutions unfiltered; institution drilldown and Admin-only reports (*operational-health*, *ai-performance*) return *HTTP 403 Forbidden*.

  2. Exporting a report to CSV (*GET /api/v1/analytics/export-csv*) prepends a leading apostrophe (*'=HYPERLINK...*, *'+SUM(1,1)*) to any cell starting with *\=*, *\+*, *\-*, *@*, *\\t*, or *\\r*, neutralizing spreadsheet formula execution (*CWE-1236*).

* **Pass/Fail Criteria:** **PASS** if role scoping, *403* guards on Admin-only reports, inline export retry, and CSV formula sanitization all pass; **FAIL** otherwise. (Note: Static placeholder values in the non-admin "Content Quality & Compliance" card is computed from live contentIssues data; INC-04 is resolved.)

2. Seed a published submission with title *"=HYPERLINK(\\"http\://evil.example/leak\\", \\"Click Here\\")"*, export the analytics CSV as Administrator, and inspect the raw CSV text; verify the cell is escaped with a leading apostrophe (*"'=HYPERLINK...*).

3. Intercept the CSV export request in the browser to force a *500* error; verify the inline error message and **"Retry Download"** button appear in *FullReportModal* without losing selected filters.

       1. ### ***Purpose***

* **Actors:** Moderator (*mod.a@dasigconnect.com* — unauthorized) and Administrator (*administrator@dasigconnect.com* — authorized).

* **Manual Job Triggers:**

  * Synchronous DB job: *ReviewLockCleanupJob* (*review\_lock\_cleanup*).

  * Asynchronous external-API job: *PublishingSchedulerJob* (*publishing\_scheduler*).

    3. ### ***Expected Outputs & Pass/Fail Criteria***

* **Expected Outputs:**

  1. Moderator or Contributor requests to */api/v1/system-health/* return *HTTP 403 Forbidden* (*UC-3.5 Preconditions*).

  2. The System Health response returns:

     * **Storage Capacity:** Database bytes and R2 bucket bytes (with DB-estimate fallback if live R2 scan fails) evaluated against *80%* (*WARNING*) and *95%* (*UNHEALTHY*) thresholds (*UC-3.5 A2*).

     * **6 External Services:** Facebook Graph API, Anthropic Claude Vision, Voyage AI, Email Service Provider, Database Health, and Media Object Storage Health (missing keys or failed probes render as *UNAVAILABLE*, never a false healthy state, *UC-3.5 A1*).

     * **16 Tracked Background Jobs:** Status (*HEALTHY*, *WARNING*, *UNHEALTHY*, *UNAVAILABLE*, *SCHEDULED*).

     * **14 Operational & AI Metrics:** 6 core workflow metrics (including *missedReviewRate* flagged *WARNING* above *10%*) \+ 8 AI telemetry metrics.

     * **Overall Page Rollup:** Worst status across all sections with item counts.

  3. Clicking **Re-run** on *ReviewLockCleanupJob* executes synchronously, returns fresh status immediately, and writes *BACKGROUND\_JOB\_RUN* to the audit log; clicking **Re-run** on *PublishingSchedulerJob* or *TokenPublishingEscalationJob* executes asynchronously (*CompletableFuture.runAsync*) and returns an immediate *"started"* acknowledgment so the HTTP request never times out during retry backoff (*UC-3.5 Main Flow*).

  4. Exporting the System Health CSV snapshot writes an audit log entry (*UC-3.5 A4*), and Facebook OAuth re-authentication updates the encrypted token and logs *TOKEN\_REAUTHORIZED* (*UC-3.5 A5*).

3. Click **Re-run** on *ReviewLockCleanupJob* (verify synchronous completion) and on *PublishingSchedulerJob* (verify immediate async *"started"* response and *BACKGROUND\_JOB\_RUN* audit log entry).

4. Export the System Health Snapshot CSV and verify audit logging.

   25. ## ***Case-25: Immutable Audit Log Review, Structured Diffs & Multi-Institution Tenant Isolation (UC-3.6, SRS 3.5)***

       1. ### ***Purpose***

Verify the Administrator-only **Audit Log** (*/admin/audit-log*, *UC-3.6*), including server-side filtering across 11 categories and 8 entity types, structured before/after diff rendering, deleted-entity badge handling (*UC-3.6 A2*), 5,000-row sanitized CSV export (*UC-3.6 A4*), database-level append-only immutability (*V78* RLS policy), and the 4-layer **Multi-Institution Tenant Isolation** security boundary (*SRS Section 3.5*).

2. ### ***Inputs***

* **Actors:**

  * Contributor A at *"CITU"* (*contrib.citu@cit.edu*).

  * Contributor B at *"Silliman University"* (*contrib.su@su.edu.ph*).

  * Administrator (*administrator@dasigconnect.com*).

* **Cross-Tenant Attack Vectors:**

  * Contributor A requests *GET /api/v1/submissions/{sub-su-id}*, *PUT /api/v1/submissions/{sub-su-id}*, and *GET /api/v1/media-assets/{asset-su-id}* belonging to *"Silliman University"*.

  * Contributor A sends *POST /api/v1/submissions* with a forged payload *{"institutionId": "\<silliman-uuid\>", ...}*.

* **Direct DB Audit Mutation Attempt:** SQL *UPDATE audit\_logs SET action \= 'TAMPERED'* and *DELETE FROM audit\_logs WHERE id \= ...*.

  3. ### ***Expected Outputs & Pass/Fail Criteria***

* **Expected Outputs:**

  1. **Cross-Institution Read/Write Isolation (SRS 3.5.4, 3.5.6):** Contributor A's direct access by ID to a "Silliman University" **media asset** returns HTTP 404 Not Found. Access to another institution's **submission** returns HTTP 403 Forbidden at the service layer (Contributors may read and edit only their own submissions); against the live database the RLS policy hides the row first, so the same request returns 404\. Either result denies access; record which one was observed.

  2. **Server-Derived Institution Identity (***SRS 3.5.2 Layer 4***):** Contributor A's forged *institutionId* in *POST /api/v1/submissions* is ignored and overridden with Contributor A's JWT-bound *"CITU"* *institution\_id*.

  3. **Audit Log Filtering & Diff View (***UC-3.6 Main Flow & A2***):** Administrator filtering */admin/audit-log* by category, action, entity type, actor, and date range returns paginated entries newest-first (*Asia/Manila*); opening an entry displays Actor details, client IP, a live jump link (or *"Deleted/Unavailable"* badge if the target entity was deleted), and a structured *Field / Previous Value / Updated Value* diff table.

  4. **Audit CSV Export (***UC-3.6 Main Flow & A4***):** Exporting filtered audit rows caps at *5,000* rows, sanitizes leading formula characters (*\=*, *\+*, *\-*, *@*), and records *AUDIT\_LOG\_EXPORTED*.

  5. **Database Append-Only Guarantee (***UC-3.6 Postconditions***,** *V78***):** Any *UPDATE* or *DELETE* executed against *audit\_logs* under the application database role is rejected/blocked by PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (migration V78).

* **Pass/Fail Criteria:** **PASS** if all 4 tenant-isolation layers return *404*/override forged tenant IDs, audit filters/diffs/exports work as specified, and *audit\_logs* rejects mutation; **FAIL** otherwise.

  4. ### ***Test Procedure***

1. Authenticate as Contributor A ("CITU") and attempt *GET, PATCH,* and *DELETE* against "Silliman University" submission and media UUIDs; assert every call is denied (404 for media; 403 or 404 for submissions, per Expected Output 1).

2. Submit a *POST /api/v1/submissions* request as Contributor A with *"Silliman University"*'s UUID in the request body; verify the created draft is bound to *"CITU"*.

3. Authenticate as Administrator, navigate to **System & Audit → Audit Log**, filter by *Edit & Revision* and *Reschedule & Override*, and open the detail drawer; verify the structured before/after diff table and *"Deleted/Unavailable"* badge on a deleted draft's audit row.

4. Export the Audit Log to CSV; verify *AUDIT\_LOG\_EXPORTED* is written and formula-prefix characters are escaped with *'*.

5. Execute an *UPDATE* and *DELETE* statement on *audit\_logs* via the application database connection; verify PostgreSQL RLS denies both operations.

| **Case-29** | *RP-04, REQ-218, SRS 3.6.4* | Mobile use at 360 px of submit, approve / request revision / reject, reschedule, resolve a failed publication, and accept an invitation | Playwright (mobile-operability.spec.ts: 360×800 and 768×1024 viewports) + JUnit (NotificationEventListenerTest) | **PASS** | Critical actions for all 5 roles verified reachable with sticky action bars and zero horizontal overflow (scrollWidth <= clientWidth); deep-linking directly into review mode (/queue?submissionId={id}&mode=review) verified. |
| **Case-30a** | *RP-01, REQ-124, UC-1.5, UC-1.9* | Submit check ("Required: 7 of 7") shown separately from optional tips, with no percentage | Playwright (*composer.spec.ts*) \+ TypeScript build verification (`calculateReadiness`, `SubmissionScreen`) | **PASS** | Implemented on `refactor/p1-submission-gate`: separated `Required: 7 of 7 ✓ — Ready to submit` gate from `Tips: X of 5 applied` with no percentage score. |
| **Case-30b** | *RP-02, REQ-125, REQ-126* | Next-action card per role, plain-language status wording, task-event log | JUnit (*TaskTelemetryServiceTest*, *TaskTelemetryControllerTest*, *NotificationEventListenerTest*) \+ Playwright (*composer.spec.ts*) | **PASS** | Implemented on `refactor/p2-first-time-independence`: `GET /api/v1/me/next-action`, shared `statusCopy`, and V124 `task_events` / `task_completion_logs`. |
| **Case-30c** | *RP-03, REQ-320, REQ-321, UC-1.6, UC-1.7* | Caption suggested automatically after image upload (Use / Edit / Dismiss), suggested media shown first, AI outcome logging | JUnit (*CaptionControllerTest*, *CaptionGenerationServiceTest*) \+ Playwright (*composer.spec.ts*) | **PASS** | Background AI caption generation on upload (`useAiCaptionAssist`), inline Use/Edit/Dismiss banner with 1–5 rating & drafting duration (`AiCaptionSuggestion`, `V130`), and media-first default (`MediaAssetsPicker`) verified on `refactor/p3-ai-caption-on-upload`. |
| **Case-30d** | *RP-05, REQ-127, UC-1.1, UC-1.3, UC-1.10* | Bulk invitations: preview each row, send through one server batch endpoint, record one batch audit entry | JUnit \+ Playwright (to be written) | **NOT EXECUTED**  | The server still accepts only one invitation per request. Planned for Sprint 9 (SPMP 5.2.2.3). |

## ***A.3 Incident Report***

This section documents software incidents, implementation discrepancies, and technical debt findings identified during verification of the SRS and its use case specifications against the DASIGConnect codebase.

### ***Open Incidents & Known Discrepancies***

| Incident ID | Related Test / UC | Severity | Description & Root Cause | Current Status & Mitigation / Resolution Plan |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **INC-03** | Case-5 (UC-1.4 A7) | **Low** | POST /api/v1/auth/refresh exists and authApi.ts defines a caller, but no screen invokes it; Stay Logged In opens the re-login modal. | Open — by design. SRS v7.0 now states the re-login behaviour, so the requirement and code agree. |
| **INC-05** | Case-24 (UC-3.5) | **Low** | SystemHealthService.escape() only doubles quotes; it does not neutralize leading \=, \+, \-, @ (CWE-1236). Not exploitable today because every snapshot cell is server-computed. | Open — defensive hardening: reuse the MetricsAggregatorService.escapeCsv() rule. |
| **INC-11** | Case-6, Case-11 (UC-1.5, UC-1.9) | **Low** | E2E `composer.spec.ts:185` (Live Event draft and submit) fails only when the suite runs with several parallel workers. In those runs the mocked submit captured `albumName: null`, `fastTrack: false`, i.e. submit happened before the album and mode were saved. It passed alone (×1) and in the 33/33 single-worker run; it failed in 4 of 4 parallel attempts. | Open — test flakiness, not a confirmed product defect. Follow-up: check whether Submit can fire before a pending autosave completes on a slow device; if so, wait for the pending save before submitting. |
| **INC-12** | Case-3 (UC-1.2) | **Low** | E2E `performance-regressions.spec.ts:96` expects the institution heading within 700 ms while counts are delayed; it misses that budget under parallel load. Passed alone and at one worker. | Open — test flakiness; loosen the 700 ms budget or run performance specs serially. |
| **INC-13** | — (performance) | **Low** | E2E `performance-regressions.spec.ts:202` intermittently fails with "Execution context was destroyed" (navigation timing in the test). Passed alone and at one worker. | Open — stabilize the test (await navigation before `page.evaluate`). |
| **INC-14** | Case-27 (SRS 3.3 GR-T1, GR-T6) | **Medium** | GR-T1 (priority flag in `SubmissionSummaryDto`) and GR-T6 (consolidation in `NotificationEventListener.onPublishFailed`) were merged in PR \#394 without automated tests. | Open — still no tests on 17 Oct (PRs \#404–\#406 added controller tests only). Add unit tests for the 30-minute flag boundary and the 5/6/7-failure consolidation boundary. |
| **INC-15** | All E2E (test environment) | **Low** | `playwright.config` sets `workers: process.env.CI ? 1 : undefined`, so local runs use many parallel workers. On a typical laptop this produced 3 to 12 timeout-driven failures per run (30 s timeouts, closed browser contexts) while the same suite passes 33/33 at one worker. | Open — use `--workers=1` (or a fixed small number) for local runs of record; consider setting `workers: 1` for the performance spec. |
| **INC-16** | Case-22 (UC-3.3 A1) | **Low** | `Documentation discrepancy: STD v1.0 and SRS v6.0 said email failures are retried. EmailDeliveryService.send makes one attempt and records failed with the error.` | Resolved in documents (STD v2.1, SRS v7.0 UC-3.3 A1). Product decision outstanding: add a retry if the 95 % / 5-minute email target (BR-NOT-01) requires it. |

### ***Resolved Incidents Verified During Regression Testing***

| Incident ID | Related Test / UC | Severity | Defect Summary | Resolution Verified |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **INC-01** | *Case-2* (*UC-1.1 A8*) | **Medium** | **Admin Owner Transfer Confirmation Blocked When Target Is an Existing Administrator:** Initiating an Admin Owner transfer (*POST /api/v1/users/{id}/initiate-owner-transfer*) to an active Moderator works end-to-end, but when the target is an already-active Administrator, the confirmation endpoint (*confirmAdminTransfer*) rejects the request due to a role-gating inconsistency on the confirmation route. | **Resolved & Verified:** Scope revised to Admin-to-Admin transfer only per PR \#395 and \#396. Fixed the role guard on `confirmAdminTransfer` to accept active Administrators matching `transferTargetUserId`, resolved the confirmation `409 Conflict`, added audit notifications, and verified end-to-end in Test 2 (**Case-2 PASS**). Outgoing owner now retains Administrator privileges without demotion.  |
| **INC-02** | *Case-21* (*UC-3.2*) | **Medium** | **Transaction Proxy Boundary in Background Escalation Jobs:** As documented in UC-3.2, *StaleSubmissionDetectorJob* and *TokenPublishingEscalationJob* invoke internal batch helper methods without an external Spring *@Transactional* proxy boundary, creating a risk of partial commits if an exception occurs mid-batch. | **Resolved & Verified (PR \#387):** Extracted `PublishingStateService` to encapsulate all transactional state mutations (`findAndMarkMissedReview`, `findAndMarkStaleScheduled`, `findAndMarkStalePublishing`, and `suspendDueToInvalidToken`). `StaleSubmissionDetectorJob` and `TokenPublishingEscalationJob` now invoke these methods via a genuine Spring `@Transactional` proxy boundary, preventing partial batch commits. Verified via unit and integration tests (**Case-21 PASS**).  |
| **INC-03** | *Case-5* (*UC-1.4 A7*) | **Low** | **Silent JWT Refresh Endpoint (***/api/v1/auth/refresh***) Unwired in Frontend:** *SRS Section 1.3 & 3.4.2* describe a silent token refresh when clicking the Session Warning Banner, whereas *UC-1.4 A7* documents that clicking **"Stay Logged In"** opens the Session Expired password modal (*POST /api/v1/auth/login*) and does not call *POST /api/v1/auth/refresh*. | **Closed (By Design / Aligned with SRS):** Intentionally unwired in favor of a stricter security posture requiring password re-entry. When the session warning banner triggers, clicking "Stay Logged In" routes to the Session Modal requiring explicit password re-authentication (`POST /api/v1/auth/login`) rather than silent token extension. Aligned in SRS Section 3.4.2 and UC-1.4 A7 specification table; verified in test execution (**Case-5 PASS**).  |
| **INC-04** | *Case-23* (*UC-3.4*) | **Low** | **Static Placeholder Values in Non-Admin "Content Quality & Compliance" Analytics Panel:** As documented in UC-3.4, the "Content Quality & Compliance" card rendered for Contributors and Moderators displays static strings ("Watermark Valid 100%", "Publish Readiness: Optimal") instead of live computed backend values. | **Resolved & Verified (2026-10-10):** Replaced hardcoded strings in `OperationsAndEngagementCard` with live computed telemetry. `"Watermark Valid"` was replaced by live **First-Time Approval** rate (`contributorAnalytics`), and `"Publish Readiness"` is now dynamically evaluated (`"Optimal"` vs. `"Needs Review"`) from backend `contentIssues` counts alongside live `contentCompleteness`.  |
| **INC-05** | *Case-24* (*UC-3.5*) | **Low** | **Un-hardened CSV Escape Helper in** *SystemHealthService.exportSnapshotCsv()***:** Unlike *MetricsAggregatorService.escapeCsv()* (*UC-3.4*) and *AuditLogService.escapeCsv()* (*UC-3.6*), which prepend *'* to neutralize leading *\=+-@* formula triggers (*CWE-1236*), *SystemHealthService.exportSnapshotCsv()* uses a basic quote-escape helper. | **Resolved & Verified (2026-10-17):** Hardened `SystemHealthService.escape()` by prepending `'` to neutralize leading formula trigger characters (`=+-@\t\r`, `CWE-1236`), aligning with `MetricsAggregatorService` and `AuditLogService`. Verified with unit test `exportSnapshotCsv_neutralizesCsvFormulaInjection` in `SystemHealthServiceTest` (`Case-24` PASS).  |
| **INC-06** | *Case-13* (*UC-2.1*) | **High** | **Uploaded Library Images Stuck in** *PROCESSING* **Forever & Dueling Auto-Match Overwrite:** *AIClassificationService.classifyAndEmbed* previously failed to transition successfully classified/embedded images from *PROCESSING* to *READY*, and backend fallback *autoMatchAlbum* overwrote the frontend's tiered album match. | **Resolved & Verified (2026-09-13 / 2026-10-09):** *classifyAndEmbed* now explicitly sets *MediaAssetStatus.READY* on completion, videos are marked *READY* immediately on upload, and *UploadModal.tsx* passes *autoMatchAlbum: false* once a frontend match is resolved. |
| **INC-07** | *Case-17* (*UC-2.4 A10*) | **High** | **Lost Edit-During-Review Diff After Review Lock Release/Re-acquisition:** *ValidationService.logsSinceLock()* previously scoped edit diffs only since the most recent *lock\_acquired* event, causing edits made prior to a lock release/timeout to be omitted (*edited \= false*) when later approved. | **Resolved & Verified (2026-09-17):** Scoped edit-diff aggregation to the entire review cycle (since the last terminal decision or start of history), surviving lock releases and re-acquisitions. |
| **INC-08** | *Case-19* (*UC-3.1 A3, A4*) | **High** | **Concurrent Reschedule Race & Missing Database-Level** *±30-Minute* **Slot Exclusion:** Moderator reschedule caps could be bypassed by parallel requests, and *GR-H1* (*±30-minute* spacing) had no database-level constraint while published submissions never released their *locked* *SlotReservation* rows. | **Resolved & Verified (***V95* **&** *V96* **Migrations):** Added atomic conditional *UPDATE* queries (*claimModeratorReschedule*/*claimAdminReschedule*), released slot reservations upon publish completion, and added a PostgreSQL GiST exclusion constraint (*V95*) with an explicit *NOT admin\_override* exemption (*V96*). |
| **INC-09** | *Case-22* (*UC-3.3*) | **Medium** | **Review-Related Notifications (***T-01***,** *T-11***) Omitted Administrators:** *NotificationEventListener.onSubmissionPending* and *onFastTrackSubmission* initially dispatched notifications only to Moderators, omitting active Administrators. | **Resolved & Verified:** Introduced *reviewers()* helper in *NotificationEventListener* to fan out review queue notifications to all active Moderators and Administrators, and added SSE *read*/*read-all* cross-session sync. |
| **INC-10** | *Case-23*, *Case-25* (*UC-3.4*, *UC-3.6*) | **High** | **CSV Formula Injection (***CWE-1236***) in Analytics and Audit Log Exports:** Free-text user fields (*event\_title*, *contributor\_name*, actor queries) starting with *\=*, *\+*, *\-*, or *@* were quoted but not formula-neutralized in CSV exports. | **Resolved & Verified:** Updated *MetricsAggregatorService.escapeCsv()* and *AuditLogService.escapeCsv()* to prepend a leading apostrophe (*'*) before quoting any cell starting with *\=*, *\+*, *\-*, *@*, *\\t*, or *\\r*. |
